Positionally, this line achieves: *White has pawn break(s) available: g5-g6 (challenging f7, h7); Black has isolated pawn(s) on h7*. **Answering the OTB Doubt:** Why couldn't Black punish this? Because if Black tries `gxh4`, you answer `Qg7!` (`14. Qg7 Rg8 15. Qxh6 Rg6 16. Qe3`, `+5.94`); and if Black tries `Bd7`, you answer `Bxg5!` (`14. Bxg5 Rg8 15. Bxe7 Qxe7 16. Qf4`, `+2.01`).
